You will build the integration solutions with quality, maintainability and do future support. Implement secure data transfers using protocols such as HTTPS, FTPS, SFTP, and AS2. Build and maintain custom functions or microservices using Java, Spring Boot, or JavaScript. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Product Discovery

jobs.title: Information Security Analyst
jobs.location_raw: Lincoln, NE, United States; Omaha, NE, United States
jobs.description_text: Your Role We're hiring Information Security Analysts to join our team, blending traditional security analysis with AI-driven workflows to protect Hudl's global operations. In this role, you'll design agentic workflows, tune detection engines and lead active response efforts to handle security threats directed against Hudl. As an Information Security Analyst, you'll: Orchestrate AI and build prompts. You'll develop high-performing prompts and design multi-step agentic workflows that ingest, enrich and correlate security data. You'll continuously tune agent behaviors to keep outputs accurate, consistent and practical. Investigate and respond to threats. You'll maintain prompt libraries for playbooks, generate clear incident summaries and guide containment efforts. As a core member of our 24/7/365 on-call and incident response team, you'll own security issues through resolution. Automate detections and prioritize vulnerabilities.
